task: which decisions are built on top of the courier y decision?
answer:
The decisions relying on "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" are "Offer 2-day delivery to west customers" and "End the west backup courier contract".

- "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" was made on 18 Aug, 12:00, and is owned by Lucas Martin.
- It assumed Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2: needs at least 90%, now it is 77%.
- "Operations meeting notes, 18 Aug" states: Agreed to move west deliveries to Courier Y to lower delivery cost (figures in the finance cost sheet). Owner: the logistics manager. Assumption recorded: Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2.
- "Operations meeting notes, 17 Sep" states: With Courier Y on target in its first weeks, the west backup courier contract ends. Assumption recorded: Hub W2 alone can carry west volume. Peaks are to be planned with marketing before each sale.
- At the same time "Run the Festive Flash Sale (40% off kitchen) in the west" was running: campaign FEST40 ran during the window; 58% of parcels through Hub W2 in the window used its coupon.
